en: Vintage black-and-white multiview postcard titled "Sinaia," showing four views: the central image is Peles Castle with multiple spired towers on a hillside; a modernist hotel/sanatorium on a mountain road; a panoramic view of the Prahova Valley resort; and a civic/casino-type building with a tower. The reverse has Romanian text, 40‑bani stamp, and Bucharest postmarks.
